recentItems.title: Saudi Crisis: India Issues Urgent Advisory, Sets Up 24/7 Helplines as Riyadh Faces Missile Threats
recentItems.description:
Saudi Crisis: India Issues Urgent Advisory, Sets Up 24/7 Helplines as Riyadh Faces Missile Threats


India has issued a safety advisory for its citizens in Saudi Arabia following a series of drone and missile strikes targeting civilian infrastructure. The advisory urges Indians to remain calm and vigilant, stay indoors during aerial attacks and follow instructions issued by local authorities. The advisory follows an October 10 attack at Riyadh airport that killed an Indian national and injured several others. Four injured Indian nationals remain in intensive care, while the Indian Embassy in Riyadh and the Consulate General in Jeddah have established 24x7 control rooms and helplines to provide emergency assistance. The Ministry of External Affairs has also cautioned Indian citizens against sharing videos or news related to the ongoing conflict. Indians in Saudi Arabia have been advised to use the official emergency contacts for consular support and updates.
